name: help-menu
title: Help Menu
description: The sidebar-footer Help item — one menu with What's new (an unread dot), Docs, Keyboard shortcuts and Contact support, and the build version; an icon with a tooltip in the collapsed rail. Links render through your router's link.

meta.whenToUse: An app's one place to learn the product, at the foot of its sidebar: what changed, the docs, the shortcuts, support and the version.
meta.whenNotToUse: The account menu (profile, theme, sign out) or a page's own help hint (InfoHint).
